text:
Which statements about the halogens are correct?
1
They are all diatomic molecules.
2
They are all gases at room temperature and pressure.
3
The density of the elements increases down the group.
4
The reactivity of the elements increases down the group.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 3
C
2 and 4
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
